title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Shelf
subtitle: 童年记忆 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 童年记忆（人与自我·生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：童年记忆（人与自我·生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：doll　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 doll 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my grandmother ① made a doll that no child in the house would have dressed, and she said the making was the whole of the winter. The ② doll, meaning the toy and not the person, sat fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; a doll, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left undressed.

Every ③ doll in that house had the same short shelf above the door of it, and the ④ doll at the end, meaning the one they kept for the little daughter and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A doll, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to dress; my grandmother said the dressing is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the doll was the whole of the story, meaning the person and not the toy. The ⑥ doll, meaning the person and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody praises and nobody listens to; doll, she said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a toy and a person. She said the person is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ doll had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short shelf. The ⑧ doll of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in January, was one house and fourteen winters of dressing; doll, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to dress. She said the dressing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ doll I remember is the one named in the list, which broke in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ doll, my mother said in 1976, is the only one that improves by being dressed; every doll, she said, is a person that has agreed to look like a toy. She said the person was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 玩偶；娃娃（指那座房子里摆着的那一只）
B. n. 玩偶；娃娃（指那只娃娃本身，与人相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a doll 做一只玩偶
D. n. 玩偶；娃娃（指留给小女儿的那一只）
E. n. 玩偶；娃娃（抽象总称，指一家人的玩偶之事）
F. n. 玩偶；娃娃（指清单上写到、被列名的那一只）
G. n. 漂亮却没有主见的人；花瓶（指故事里被人夸却无人听的那个人）
H. n. 花瓶般的人（抽象总称，指人人称赞却无人倾听的那种人）

items.q: made a doll that no child in the house would have dressed
The doll, meaning the toy and not the person
the doll was the whole of the story
the doll had become a line in a list
The doll of the whole thing
A doll, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: make a doll 意为“做一只玩偶”，1953 年祖母做了一只屋子里没有一个孩子肯给它穿衣的玩偶。
doll 意为“玩偶、娃娃”，指那只娃娃本身而不是人，它在屋子里坐了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
doll 意为“玩偶、娃娃”，指那座房子里的每一只玩偶，每一只门上方都有同一块小小的搁板。
doll 意为“玩偶、娃娃”，指留给小女儿的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
doll 意为“漂亮却没有主见的人、花瓶”，指故事里被人夸却无人倾听的那个人，姑姑说这个人就是那个故事的全部。
doll 意为“花瓶般的人”，指人人称赞却无人倾听的那种人而不是那只娃娃，是故事里人人都夸、却无人倾听的东西。
doll 意为“玩偶、娃娃”，指清单上写到、被列名的那一只，到 1962 年这只玩偶成了清单里的一行。
doll 意为“玩偶、娃娃”，祖母一月写道，整件事的玩偶之事是一座房子和十四个冬天的穿衣。
doll 意为“玩偶、娃娃”，我记得的是清单上列名的那一只，1974 年破了，至今仍被说成屋子里最安静的一只。
doll 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，一只玩偶是唯一会因为被好好穿衣而变得更好的东西。

items: 1953 年祖母做了一只屋子里没有一个孩子肯给它穿衣的玩偶，她说做着才是那个冬天的全部。（make a doll）
那只玩偶，指的是那只娃娃本身而不是人，在屋子里坐了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。（doll）

末尾那一只玩偶，指的是她们留给小女儿的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（doll）
姑姑说这个人就是那个故事的全部，指的是那个人而不是那只娃娃。（doll）
